verdict.rationale: The public, machine-readable docs cover the whole agent loop. Auth uses API credentials with scopes and short-lived JWTs. Jobs can be created either synchronously (POST /aiservices/scribe/transcribe) or as batch jobs (POST /aiservices/scribe/jobs). Results come back via status, list-files and get-file endpoints with defined job states, or via signed completion webhooks. All of this is backed by a live OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and .md doc pages that probes confirmed. Missing for 10: the exact steps for minting a JWT from the API key/secret are only lightly documented in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on report of an agent running submission-to-transcript end to end.
